caption: The drawing depicts a metal tankard with a hinged lid and an ornate handle. The main body of the tankard is cylindrical and slightly tapers towards the top, with a wide base that is accentuated by circular bands near the bottom and below the lid. The lid is domed and fits snugly over the top, attached to the handle by a hinge and a decorative thumb lever for lifting the lid. The handle is broad, curved, and features an embellishment at the lower end that extends outward and ends in a flat, engraved piece. The handle is joined to the tankard at the top and bottom. The drawing is in grayscale, with shading used to suggest the metallic texture and rounded form of the tankard. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset diagram of the tankard shown in profile, rendered with simple outlines only, emphasizing the overall shape and proportions, including the profile of the handle and lid. The composition is centered with the tankard occupying most of the space, framed within a faint rectangular border. The paper has a slightly yellowed tone, and the drawing is executed with fine pencil or graphite lines and delicate shading.
title: Silver Tankard
